defect: the attended set filters the perspective pool by declared inputs, but one attention candidate was named observation, which is not a workspace region. The one perspective that reads the perceptual region was therefore dropped by attention on every cycle at every budget, including an unlimited one
correction: candidate ids are region names, and a regression test requires every candidate to name a region that at least one perspective declares as an input
reproduced_by: reproduced by the closure gate certification run
rule: a reproduced defect overrides reviewer votes and becomes a permanent regression test
